propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeSnowSensor
propertySets.definition: Properties that are applicable for IfcSensor with predefined type SNOWDEPTHSENSOR.

properties.name: MarginOfError
properties.definition: Indicates the margin of error of the measurement.

properties.name: SamplingFrequency
properties.definition: Indicates the sampling frequency of the device.

properties.name: DataCollectionType
properties.definition: Indicates the type or manner of data collection.

properties.name: ImageResolution
properties.definition: Indicates the image resolution of snow depth meter.

properties.name: ImageShootingMode
properties.definition: Indicates the type or manner of snow depth meter image shooting.

properties.name: SerialInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of serial interface used by the device.

properties.name: LengthMeasureResolution
properties.definition: Indicates the resolution for length measure of the device.

properties.name: SnowSensorMeasureRange
properties.definition: Indicates the measuring range of snow depth meter.

properties.name: SnowSensorType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of snow depth meter.
